latestVersionDriver.title: HP LaserJet MFP M232-M237 Printer series Firmware Update Utility(not compatible with HP LaserJet MFP M234d/M235sdw Printer)

detailInformation.description:
NOTE: This firmware utility DOES NOT support HP LaserJet MFP M234d and M235sdw Printer. Please make sure to download the Firmware Update Utility specific to your Printer model.

This utility is for use on Microsoft Windows 32 and 64 bit operating systems. The utility can be used with a USB connection or network connection. Be sure to use the firmware utility that is specific to your printer model. This utility updates the printer firmware version to the latest version. The firmware version can be found on the Self Test/Configuration Page which can be printed from the printer's Reports menu.

Reminder: Dynamic security enabled printer. This Firmware includes dynamic security measures, which are used to block cartridges using a non-HP chip or modified or non-HP electronic circuitry. The printer is intended to work only with new or reused cartridges that have a new or reused HP chip or circuitry. Periodic firmware updates will maintain the effectiveness of the dynamic security measures and block cartridges that previously worked. More at: www.hp.com/learn/ds.

Exclusively for HP customers: Accelerate your digitization journey with ReadIRIS Advanced OCR. Convert paper documents, scanned images, and PDFs into fully editable and searchable digital files, making information easier to store, share, and manage.

HP customers enjoy exclusive access to ReadIRIS Advanced PDF – your complete solution for digital document workflows. Merge, split, annotate, and secure PDFs effortlessly, helping you streamline processes and embrace a paperless future.

HP Scan OCR Add-on Software provides OCR and OCR related functionalities and is designed to be used as a plugin for HP Scan Software. This add-on is already available as part of the HP Scan Full Webpack.

latestVersionDriver.title: Install HP app to complete setup and support

detailInformation.description:
Install HP app to setup and use your Printer
  • HP app will help you connect your printer, install driver, offer print, scan, fax, share files and Diagnose/Fix top issues. Click here to learn how to setup your Printer successfully (Recommended).
  • Creating an HP Account and registering is mandatory for HP+/Instant-ink customers. It also helps in accessing assisted support options and more.
NOTE:
  • Disconnect from Virtual Private Network (VPN) connection before downloading.
  • Creating an account on Microsoft Store to download HP app is optional.
